# Illuminated acanthus

Red, blue and gold acanthus corners, dividers, frames, margin rods, sprigs and a muse figure in the style of a 15th-century Flemish illuminated border, AI-generated by adrian729 from style references for the Polyhymnia app.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `illuminated-acanthus`, authored, 36 assets, version 2.0.2.

## Use one asset

Pin the exact version (never `@latest`). For `illuminated-acanthus/corner-bottom-left`:

```html
<img src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ranx729/ducktape-assets-illuminated-acanthus@2.0.2/webp/corner-bottom-left-512.webp" alt="" loading="lazy">
```

Package `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-illuminated-acanthus`; every file, width and format is listed in its `manifest.json`. Masters live in git under `assets/<id>/` and in `@ranx729/ducktape-assets-illuminated-acanthus-masters`; never put a master on a page.
